doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The relaxed Cannonball Adderley session with Miles Davis
summary: Jones recalls the 1958 date with Miles, Sam Jones and Art Blakey as the most relaxed he ever did, on Van Gelder's piano.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: What do you remember about your Cannonball Adderley session?

Very relaxed. You know, Miles was sort of the unofficial leader of the date. Most of the ideas, the playing ideas, the subtle things, all came from Miles. The whole date was so relaxed. I guess, I would have to say that is the most relaxed date I have ever done. There was Sam Jones, Art Blakey, and Miles, and Cannonball. Everything just fell right into place. There was no stress, no sweat. Everything worked out nice. And the piano, of course, it was Rudy Van Gelder's piano.
When you did that date, do you reflect upon the previous recordings you did with him at Savoy?
